issues.description: fixed_audio_packet_size lacks validation against sample width/rate, allowing silently malformed PCM
issues.detail: The packet size is an untyped integer with no precondition that it be a multiple of sample_width * num_channels, and no link to vonage_sample_rate. A misconfigured value (e.g. 641 on 16-bit mono) produces half-sample tearing at every boundary. Either enforce the invariant at setup or express the value as duration-at-rate.

issues.description: Sub-packet tail bytes are never flushed on stream end or disconnect
issues.detail: The _audio_send_buffer holds 0 to packet_bytes-1 residual bytes that are silently discarded on disconnect or end-of-utterance. There is no zero-pad-and-flush, no log, no documented intent. Either pad-and-send on end-of-stream or explicitly document that sub-packet tails are dropped by design.

issues.description: Packetization complects buffering, pacing, and chunking inside _write_frame with no stated invariant
issues.detail: The chunking loop is a pure function pretending to be a method, entangling mutable buffer state, fixed-size splitting, and send pacing. No invariant is stated linking buffer drain to _next_send_time, and there is no termination argument tying packet emission to wall-clock. Extract chunk_pcm(buffer, size) as a pure, unit-testable function.

issues.description: Chunking guard discriminates on payload type rather than frame type
issues.detail: The buffer guard is isinstance(payload, (bytes, bytearray)) rather than isinstance(frame, AudioRawFrame). Any serializer emitting non-audio bytes (control payloads, headers) will be chopped into PCM-sized chunks. The precondition 'payload is raw PCM' is never stated nor checked.

issues.description: DTMF parsing accommodates two payload shapes with no documented spec
issues.detail: deserialize uses message.get('digit') or message.get('dtmf', {}).get('digit'), encoding uncertainty about the Vonage protocol as runtime behavior. Pick the shape that matches the spec, log loudly when the other appears, and remove the speculative fallback once confirmed.

issues.description: Stateful resamplers are never reset on interruption or reconfigure
issues.detail: Input and output resamplers carry filter history across calls. On InterruptionFrame the byte buffer clears but resampler state persists, producing artifacts on the next utterance; if sample_rate changes mid-session the state goes stale. Either reset on setup/interrupt or document that the resampler is stateless.

synthesis.summary: The PR adds a Vonage serializer and fixed-size audio packetization to the FastAPI WebSocket transport. The serializer is reasonably clean, but the transport-side packetization is under-specified: no validation that packet size aligns with sample width/rate, no flush of sub-packet tails on stream end, no stated invariant linking the drain loop to pacing, and discrimination on payload type rather than frame type. DTMF parsing and resampler lifecycle also encode uncertainty as behavior. Verdict: state the spec, extract the chunking as a pure function, and enforce the packet-size precondition before merge.
